subject: Interview environment access & interviewer coverage for Nora Patel

Cc: 
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro: Nora Patel availability for ML coding screen + resume attached

Hi Sean / Kimberly,

Thanks for taking a look. Nora Patel is our lead candidate for the ML engineer role — attached is her resume. She can do a live coding + small ML discussion on Monday 7/13 between 10:00-13:00 PT or Tuesday 7/14 after 14:00 PT.

Preferred format: 45m coding (CoderPad) + 15m debrief. Hiring team requested ability to run a small PyTorch snippet and a short dataset question, so please confirm if the environment / dependencies are available.

Attachments: Nora_Patel_resume.pdf

Next steps I suggest:
- Can you confirm a 60m slot on Monday or Tuesday?
- If you want the coding prompt, I can provide it or you can use Redwood's in-house prompt (up to you).

Thanks,

Kimberly / Marcus — thanks Aisha for the intro.

I can take Monday 7/13 10:00-11:00 PT (preferred) or Tuesday 7/14 14:00-15:00 PT. Marcus, can you join as second interviewer for the ML portion? If not, Kimberly, we'll pair and you can handle the systems/infra questions.

A couple operational asks before I lock the invite:
- Do we have a CoderPad session that supports PyTorch imports? If not, can we give candidate a short Docker-backed snippet?
- I have a short prompt ready (45m + 15m debrief). I'm attaching the prompt (coding-problem.md) so ops can confirm.

Attachments: coding-problem.md

If everyone confirms, I'll send the calendar invite to Nora and Aisha and include the CoderPad link.

—Sean

Sean / Marcus — good plan. I can cover infra/system questions and act as backup proctor. Marcus, if you can do the ML model discussion, that'd be ideal.

Operational notes (please read):
- I created a CoderPad session that has numpy, pandas and PyTorch preinstalled: https://coderpad.io/session/AB12CD34 (expires in 72h).
- I've attached the calendar invite (coderpad-invite.ics) and the candidate-facing instructions we send to interviewees. Please do not forward the internal prompt.
- If we expect the candidate to run a small dataset step, the session will allow file uploads (limit 5MB). Let me know if we need a larger sample and I can host a temp Drive link.
- On interviewer coverage: Sean (lead), Marcus (ML), Kimberly (infra + debrief). If Marcus gets pulled, I'll cover ML discussion at a high level and route detailed model questions to the take-home follow-up.

Attachments: coderpad-invite.ics
Related doc: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B_example_runbook (interview runbook & debrief rubric)

Thanks — confirming Monday 7/13 10:00-11:00 PT unless someone objects by EOD.

-Kim
